items.prompt: union(a,b) finds that both endpoints already have the same representative. What happens to the component count?

options.text: It decreases again because an edge arrived
options.why: A new edge need not merge two different components.

options.text: It stays unchanged because the partition did not merge
options.why: Repeated connectivity does not reduce the number of sets.
No new elements are created by this operation.

options.text: It becomes the numeric representative ID
options.why: An ID and a count have different meanings.

items.explanation: Count successful merges of distinct sets, not the number of union calls or edge observations.
